verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state the Agents SDK understands multiple MCP transports, letting users reuse or build MCP servers to expose filesystem, HTTP, or connector-backed tools to an agent, and also lists 'hosted MCP' as a built-in tool option. This directly satisfies the story of plugging MCP servers in as tool sources. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically confirming MCP integration works in practice (community evidence in the pack is about unrelated topics like sandboxes and comparisons to LangChain).
